name: context-loop-collapse-covers-one-variant
body: Collapsing the `[Context; N]` loop to a single `Context::Lint` assertion removed the loop's automatic coverage: if a third `Context` variant is ever added, this test no longer exercises it automatically and a divergence between `Lint` and the new variant would go unnoticed here. Upgrade by restoring a per-context loop over the production variants at that point — the sibling `component_implementation_presence_is_context_dependent` carries the same shape and the same limit.
